## Overview

Ruby entry point for loading and fetching software definitions.
## Interface

- `omnibus-software.rb:OmnibusSoftware.root/verify!/fetch/fetch_all/fetch_software/list` expose catalog helpers backed by Omnibus and HighLine.
- [omnibus-software](./omnibus-software/README.md) — Gem version constant.
## Invariants

- `omnibus-software.rb:for_each_software` loads config/software/*.rb with a sample project; verify! loads DSL definitions, not full builds.
- `omnibus-software.rb:fetch_all` skips definitions without a source URL.
## Side Effects

- `omnibus-software.rb:fetch_software` changes Omnibus cache directory, disables S3 caching, enables debug logging and downloads sources; list/verify! print output; definition loading reads files and changes local_software_dirs.
## Verification

From the `omnibus-software` repository root after installing the Gemfile dependencies: `bundle exec rake test` loads all software definitions; `bundle exec rake style` checks Ruby style. Full platform builds are separate and execute the build side effects above.
